attBesluta.text: Great product that was easily installed without using the overdoor hooks as I was happy to install as a permanent fixture. I pretty much filled the racks with most of my smaller pantry items and have so much more space and organisation. Very happy

This gives me so much more storage space in my pantry. I wish I bought it sooner. It was easy to put together and hang. It is sold and strong and odes not move at all! I am very happy with my purchase.
It works really well. I screwed in a few places to make it sturdier and am happy with our purchase.

Great product. Easy to assemble. Light weight yet sturdy. Very versatile. Can hold so, so much. The best part (apart from the price): you can swap them around, depending on the products you need to organise on the shelves/in the baskets. Have ordered more to create a separate baking section. Once seen set up in the kitchen, a friend wanted some ordered for their pantry. We fixed them to the wall, removed the door attachments. Great delivery. Great service from Vevor! Simply love these racks!
